items.titel: NEU A Mazzera's Hunting Charm – Ausdauer +1 (Leiste 8 → 9)
items.soll: Anhänger: a striking dark hunter's talisman: two curved wild boar tusks joined tip to tip into a crescent moon, the ivory etched with fine black spiral engravings, bound at the joints with bright blood-red thread, a single smooth milky moonstone set in the middle, three glossy black raven feathers with a blue-violet sheen fanning out below, hanging from a braided red cord with an old blackened silver ring. Wirkung an der Jacke: Ausdauer +1 (Leiste 8 → 9). Bekommt man: Unikat der Berge, nicht verschenkbar.
